citation.title: Reduced Critical Rotation for Resistive-Wall Mode Stabilization in a Near-Axisymmetric Configuration
citation.authors: H. Reimerdes, A. M. Garofalo, G. L. Jackson, M. Okabayashi, E. J. Strait, et al.

topic: DIII-D resistive-wall mode stabilization threshold vs. toroidal rotation measured by CER using C VI
own_question: How low can the q=2 toroidal rotation fall before the RWM destabilizes when torque is reduced with balanced NBI and no magnetic braking?
actual_method_and_evidence: DIII-D discharges with NBI torque ramp-downs and an error-field-corrected configuration were compared with a magnetic-braking discharge. Carbon-impurity CER rotation was analyzed offline. MARS-F kinetic and sound-wave damping calculations were also performed. There was no temperature estimation, nowcasting, BES/ECEI use, or KSTAR data.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Carbon-impurity charge-exchange measurements are conventionally used as proxies for main-ion quantities. The authors note that the impurity–deuterium difference is predicted by neoclassical theory but is not fully understood.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.2, paragraph on CER diagnostic using C VI
claim_checks.qualification: This concerns rotation, not temperature, on DIII-D. It supports only a general caveat about impurity versus main-ion quantities.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. No report timing, latency, or real-time use is described.
validation_if_relevant: Not applicable. The study uses physics experiments and code comparisons, not predictive validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper as evidence for Ti nowcasting or CES temperature labels.
Do not claim this paper shows a need for real-time CES estimation.
Do not treat the MARS-F agreement as proven physics; the authors call it suggestive.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: The paper is about MHD and rotation thresholds and is off-topic for causal CES temperature nowcasting. At most, it could serve as an optional citation for the impurity-versus-main-ion caveat; better dedicated sources exist, such as the Solomon 2006 paper it cites.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
